beats.summary: Michael organizes Movie Monday, showing Varsity Blues and other videos to the office staff.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Movie Monday! The only cure I know for the Monday blues is… Varsity Blues!
Pam: Movie Monday started with training videos, but we went through those pretty fast.

beats.summary: Jan disapproves of Movie Monday, questioning its effect on productivity and expressing displeasure to Michael.

evidence.snippet: Jan: How would a movie increase productivity Michael? How on earth would it do that?

beats.summary: Angela is worried Michael's Movie Monday will get them all fired and urges Dwight to confront Jan.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Michael is going to get us all fired.

beats.summary: Dwight calls Jan to discuss a sensitive matter about Michael and arranges to meet her at a shopping outlet.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Pull over at exit 40. There is a Liz Claiborne outlet. I know you like that store.
Jan: How do you know I like that store?

beats.summary: Dwight proposes to Jan that he should run the branch, promising to eliminate waste and clean house.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I can save the branch.
Dwight: If you let me run it.

notable_quotes.quote: People work faster after… they have to… to make up for the time they lost watching the movie.
notable_quotes.speaker: Michael

evidence.snippet:
Michael: People work faster after…
Jan: Magically?
Michael: No… they have to… to make up for the time they lost watching the movie.

notable_quotes.quote: The decision to turn on Michael was difficult. But once I did it, I didn't look back.
notable_quotes.speaker: Dwight

evidence.snippet: Dwight: The decision to turn on Michael was difficult. But once I did it, I didn't look back.

notable_quotes.quote: Reject a woman and she will never let it go.
notable_quotes.speaker: Dwight

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Ever since Michael dumped Jan for Carol, Jan's been bitching out on him. Reject a woman and she will never let it go.

notable_quotes.quote: Fashion show! Fashion show! Fashion show at lunch!
notable_quotes.speaker: Kelly

evidence.snippet: Kelly (clapping her hands in unison): Fashion show! Fashion show! Fashion show at lunch! Fashion show! Fashion show! Fashion show at lunch!
